notices.title: I've hunted down every confirmed GTA 6 gun in its trailers and screenshots so far
notices.contentSnippet: There are tons of pistols, an obligatory rocket launcher, and a couple of Red Dead Redemption 2 references.

notices.title: Eric Barone gives players a small update on Haunted Chocolatier's progress: 'It’s not a simple task, as I torture myself over every last detail'
notices.contentSnippet: Good things come to those who wait.

notices.title: 'Generational talent just gone': Developers react in shock at the brutal scale of Bungie layoffs, which has reportedly seen the Destiny 2 team almost completely wiped out
notices.contentSnippet: Many of those being let go are showing incredible dignity in the face of a gigantic squandering of talent.

notices.title: Deltarune Chapter 5 launches to nearly 300,000 concurrent players on Steam, Chapter 6 is coming in 2027
notices.contentSnippet: People sure seem to like Deltarune.

notices.title: 1 year after launch, spaceship shooter Wildgate will end development after its next update
notices.contentSnippet: Thankfully, it's not shutting down, and developer Moonshot Games says no layoffs are planned.

notices.title: I've played countless Doom engine games, so believe me when I say this one that combines the FPS with JRPG combat might be the coolest one in 30 years
notices.contentSnippet: Free Doom total conversion End of Starchild is part bullet hell, part surprise RPG, all enigma.

notices.title: PC Gamer's 2025 GOTY is yours for a ludicrous $24 during the Steam Summer Sale
notices.contentSnippet: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 is 60% off, and Warhorse is celebrating with a free quest.

notices.title: The best farm sim since Stardew Valley is on sale right before its 1.0 launch
notices.contentSnippet: Fields of Mistria is leaving Early Access in August, so now is a perfect time to grab it at a discount.

notices.title: It's not layoffs, but you can see them from here: Numerous Compulsion Games employees are looking for new jobs
notices.contentSnippet: The sudden influx of "open to work" posts suggests that fears of major Xbox layoffs in the near future are well founded.

notices.title: It's wild of Rockstar to ask us for $80, minimum, without showing a GTA 6 gameplay trailer
notices.contentSnippet: I really didn't think they'd open pre-orders without a new trailer, but here we are.

notices.title: The Steam Summer Sale goes live with 'deep-a** discounts' across thousands of games
notices.contentSnippet: Don't blame me, that's what they said.

notices.title: Valve says Steam Machine won't have 'as long of a timeframe' as Steam Deck, and new models are 'just a matter of when it makes sense'
notices.contentSnippet: The Steam Machine is passé. I'm all about the Steam Machine 2.
